ui.quick_release.fire_locked.source: 尚未获得用火球术解除拘束具的能力。
ui.quick_release.fire_locked.text: Requires the ability to cast Fireball on restraints.

ui.quick_release.fire_empty.source: 没有拘束具可供火球术选为目标。
ui.quick_release.fire_empty.text: No restraints to target with Fireball.

ui.quick_release.help.source: 先选部位再点牌，或直接拖牌；右键切小部位，左右箭头切换拘束具。
ui.quick_release.help.text: Select a body part, then click or drag a card. Right-click to cycle parts; Left/Right cycles restraints.

ui.quick_release.wrong_card.source: 这张牌不能用于当前选中的拘束具
ui.quick_release.wrong_card.text: This card cannot be used on the selected restraint.

ui.quick_release.exploration.source: 切换至快捷挣脱栏，可对选中的拘束具使用解除牌，也可使用已安装道具。
ui.quick_release.exploration.text: Switch to quick escape to use release cards on the selected restraint and access installed items.

ui.home.disclaimer.source:
免责声明：本游戏为爱发电，免费发布。
如果你花钱购买了本游戏，说明你上当了。
ui.home.disclaimer.text:
Disclaimer: This game is a passion project, released free of charge.
If you paid for this game, you were scammed.

ui.settings.vsync_note.source: 开启垂直同步可减少画面撕裂；即使选择无上限，帧率仍可能受显示器刷新率限制。
ui.settings.vsync_note.text: Vertical sync reduces screen tearing. Even with Unlimited selected, the display refresh rate may still limit FPS.
